method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 在洗衣服、整理 Tommy 床铺时发现一张从墙缝滑出的打印纸，上面是一首诗。
facts.anchor: She found the poem while doing laundry.

facts.fact: 圣诞节只剩十天，家里的男人外出砍圣诞树；Tommy 十六岁，马上要上大学。
facts.anchor: Tommy was sixteen now and college was right around the corner

facts.fact: 纸上是用普通 Times New Roman 打印的诗，开头是“Your cold arms tighten with love”。
facts.anchor: Your cold arms tighten with love

facts.fact: 诗中写着想用刀割对方，并出现“心总会回家”的句子。
facts.anchor: Like the knife I want to cut you with

facts.fact: Hattie 把诗读了一遍、两遍、第三遍，感觉体内像有关键的一块脱落下坠。
facts.anchor: She read it once, then again, and a third time.

facts.fact: 她下意识把纸揉成一团，上楼到客厅后又把它展开重读。
facts.anchor: She grasped the paper, crumpling it before she knew she was going to do so.

facts.fact: Hattie 把纸塞进壁炉的火焰，看着字迹变暗、卷曲成灰。
facts.anchor: Hattie shoved the page into the flames, and they leaped higher.

facts.fact: 她去厨房热牛奶做蛋奶酒，自我安慰说这是 Mr. Hennessy 布置的英语课作业，却明知他不教诗。
facts.anchor: she told herself it was an assignment, something Mr. Hennessy had given Tommy’s English class

facts.fact: 她决定先放一放、以后多留意 Tommy；看到雪中归来的父子拖着圣诞树，她认定“诗只是一首诗，伤不了人”。
facts.anchor: A poem was just a poem. It couldn’t hurt anyone.
